svg.title: Three gaps in the router, found by reading the code. A failed cheap answer never moves up to premium: it tries other cheap models, then gives up; part 4 adds the escalation. The quality check is word matching, so a wrong answer containing the right words passes; the course has no fix for this. The final error only remembers crashes, so when every answer failed the check it reads "No acceptable response: None"; remembering the last rejected answer too would say what happened.
